entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been waiting forever. I want to return this ridiculous jersey I bought. It's completely useless.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could I get your order number?
It's VF8675309. And don't give me the runaround. I bought this a while ago and it's been sitting in the box. I tried it on and it's just the wrong size. It's way too tight.
Okay, I have your order pulled up. I see the ProFit Jersey. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the item or a preference issue with the fit?

What kind of a stupid question is that? I just told you it's too tight! It's the wrong size! I want to do an exchange or get my money back. This is unbelievable. If you don't sort this out, I'm lighting you up on every review site on the internet. Get me your manager.
I understand your frustration, sir, and there's no need for a manager. I can handle this for you. Let me just confirm one thing in our system regarding your purchase date.
Yeah, you do that. I'm sure you're just looking for a reason to tell me 'no'. Just get on with it.

Thank you for your patience. I see here that you received the jersey 75 days ago. That is well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for you right now. No problem at all.
Oh. Really? It's... it's within the policy?
Yes, absolutely. We can either process a full refund to your original payment method, or I can help you set up an exchange for a different size. Whichever you prefer.
Well, okay then. An exchange would be great, actually. I guess I just assumed it would be a fight. Thank you.

Of course. I'm happy to help. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to your email now and processing the order for the new size. You should see it within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
